name: Taming the Beast
summary: Grif Wildheart’s final trial in Kharanos tests a dwarf hunter’s control over a wild bear. You use an enchanted rod to subdue an aggressive Ice Claw Bear and learn to understand it. Passing unlocks the abilities to tame, call, and dismiss a permanent wild companion.

sections.title: The Strength of the Wild
sections.body: Mountaineers and scouts across Dun Morogh rely on hardy beasts in its freezing crags. After students practice on swift, cunning predators, master huntsman Grif Wildheart sends you to capture an Ice Claw Bear. The bears prowl the snowdrifts east of Kharanos. Their raw strength and endurance test the control every dwarven huntsman must learn.

sections.title: Earning a Companion
sections.body: The Taming Rod trials teach you how wild instincts answer to will and calm intent. The rod holds the bear docile, making your bond temporary and the exercise educational. Return the rod to Grif to complete the formal trials. He then shares the lasting secrets of beast mastery: pacifying a compatible wild creature and calling upon it throughout your life of adventure.

faq.q: What animal do I need to tame for this quest?
faq.answer: You need to tame an Ice Claw Bear, which prowls the frozen foothills east of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. The Taming Rod subdues it so you can learn to handle raw brute force.

faq.q: Do I keep the Ice Claw Bear after turning in the quest?
faq.answer: No. The Ice Claw Bear subdued by the Taming Rod is only a temporary test of discipline and skill. When you return the rod to Grif Wildheart, the bear departs, and you gain the abilities to tame any wild beast you choose.
Grif Wildheart is outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Dun Morogh. He trains fledgling hunters in marksmanship and beast mastery.

faq.q: What abilities do I learn upon finishing this trial?
faq.answer: This final trial teaches you the foundational hunter abilities Tame Beast, Call Pet, and Dismiss Pet. They let you venture into the world with a permanent companion.

faq.q: What is the next step after completing this quest?
faq.answer: Grif sends you onward with Training the Beast, where you learn to feed, nurture, and instruct your new companion so it stays loyal in combat.

faq.q: Why does Grif have hunters test multiple types of beasts?
faq.answer: The three trials introduce you to different fighting styles: agility, cunning, and brute power. These temperaments prepare a mountaineer to choose the companion that best suits their hunting style.

angles.text: As a hunter, you begin as an isolated archer and become a true pet-taming hunter, with the essential abilities to tame and summon beasts.
As a dwarf, you know bears as iconic companions of Dun Morogh’s mountaineers, renowned for matching their masters’ stubborn resilience.
